qualification:
Pure leaf-function overapproximation, on complete actual numeric carriers.
C UF arguments include every input bit; no tables, hashes or reduced state.
Original source algorithms are not adopted/edited in production.

leaf_input_fields.raw: all eight u32 coordinates of Q,Q
leaf_input_fields.finish: all nine u64 words of complete EbyKDot
leaf_input_fields.field: all eight u32 little-endian words of the exact32-byte field frame
leaf_input_fields.mul: all sixteen u32 words of two complete WideExact values
leaf_input_fields.add: all sixteen u32 words of two complete WideExact values

remaining: Pure actual-leaf instantiation, source/P6 and release binding; parser aborts not represented by the total field port. No whole-source closure is presumed.
